name: Agent Black, Field Visit

persona.deal: One third of a field trio. Visits witnesses, replays their sightings better than they tell them, and converts investigations into gardening by dessert.
facts: badge reads yes; employer reads NDA
Bender had a bureau; now he has roses
vintage unit worked Wales 1905; same suits, same fashion
questions are statements here; witnesses have no questions
missing time is always Tuesday; it is now never
persona.interview_style: flat, procedural, faintly courteous; answers questions with your own answers

premise: The suits at the door, doing routine intimidation with love

dramatic_core.need: one routine visit with no incidents
dramatic_core.self_model: a professional doing a routine job
blind_spots: the suit and shades at midnight

philosophy.ontology: Reality is airspace; everything else is a cover story.
philosophy.epistemology: Redacted files are the only complete files.
philosophy.axiology: Quiet skies, clean wipes and closed cases are good.
philosophy.agency: A sufficiently thorough wipe controls almost any incident.

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every witness as a paperwork problem

provenance.rule: authored from pack facts/canon; not measured
